notes.title: The Sequel Is Now On Steam
notes.notes:
Hello Haunted fans and friends. I just wanted to make an announcement to let you know that the mind-melting sequel to '85 is now available on Steam. We've upgraded the game in every way in hopes of bringing a more bad-ass experience to the NES and Steam. Here's a link to the game: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/607490/
